title: Wrote Gemini an essay. Got told to ask for something else. Twice.
context: A user poured a whole essay into the prompt box, expecting a masterpiece. Gemini burned both attempts and came back with a polite shrug. The essay itself wasn't shared, only the reply.

exchanges.prompt: A whole essay of a prompt (the poster's description; the text wasn't shown)
exchanges.response: Normally I can help with things like this, but I don't seem to have access to that content. You can try again or ask me for something else.

roast: "Normally I can help with things like this." Normally. So the problem is you, specifically, today.
"I don't seem to have access to that content." The content was typed directly into the box. It is the one thing Gemini has guaranteed access to. It was right there.
This was attempt 2 of 2. Google ran the slot machine twice and both pulls landed on "no." Even the regenerate button gave up.
And the top tier model name was sitting in the corner the whole time, Argon High, like a guy in a suit holding the door shut.
"Ask me for something else" is not an answer. It is a customer service phone tree with a sparkle icon.
verdict: Read an essay, forgot it existed, then asked you to change the subject.
